bugs.title: Name stops at 100 characters on 19 screens, although 150 was confirmed; 6 screens have no limit at all (new in stage build v1.0.2)
bugs.steps:
1. Core > Application > Role > Add Role
2. Type 150 characters in Name
bugs.expected: All 150 characters kept, the same limit on every screen (product owner; was BUG-33 for Tax only)
bugs.actual: Stops at 100: State, City, Market, Desk Location, Province, Role, Status, Tax, Exchange Type, Account, Branch, Department, Product Type, Product Class, View Type, Room Category, Supplement, Allotment, Addon. Keeps 150: Theme, Amenity. No limit (300 kept): Account Group, Language, Room Type, Resource Type, Personnel, Asset

bugs.title: Names are no longer trimmed and lose digits and & ( ) on more screens - duplicates get saved and the list sorts wrongly (new in stage build v1.0.2)
bugs.steps:
1. Core > Region > State > Add State
2. Name "   QA Auto State X edited   " (same as an existing State, spaces around) > Save
3. Add Role, type "Zone 2 North-1 & Co (Test)"
bugs.expected: Spaces trimmed, duplicate refused ("already exists"), what the user types is kept (as before v1.0.2)
bugs.actual: Duplicate with spaces is SAVED (State, Market, Resource Type) and stored with the spaces, so it sorts above "Admin"; digits removed in Role, Status, Branch, Department, Exchange Type; "& ( )" removed in State, Market, Landmark, Province, Role, Status, Branch, Department, Exchange Type ("Edge & Co (Test)" -> "Edge Co Test"). Same as BUG-22/25/26, now spread beyond Product
